content: Approximately 0.2% of the administered dose of drospirenone (DRSP) was excreted into the breast milk of postpartum females within 24 hours. This results in a potential maximum daily dose of less than 1 microgram of DRSP for an infant. This level is generally considered acceptable. Controlled studies conducted in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk. For proper drug disposal, do not flush medications down the toilet. Instead, follow the recommended guidelines provided at government-approved drug disposal sites.
